en: An old monochrome postcard showing a large neoclassical building with arcades on the ground floor, three main stories, and two side towers. In front is a landscaped garden with paths, trees, and people walking. The right margin of the card has printed vertical text in French and Greek, and there is handwritten cursive text over part of the image. The building is identified as the central post and telegraph office.
